answer: Make every epoch's reward pool fixed and split equally among attested heads: each extra head a farm mints dilutes its own payout. A sybil operator would forge dozens of heads on a quiet knoll, only to watch each new one thin the dividend for all the others — the optimal farm size computes itself down to nothing, while a lone honest agent's share holds steady like a cedar. Growth becomes self-defeating, so the attack's economics collapse before any detection is even needed.
